summary: Convert the normalized spatial source balance S+Beta_CX-alpha*F+OmegaM+Swall from F/m to the physical Boltzmann distribution-rate RHS in F/s by one explicit Vth multiplication.

capability: Convert the normalized spatial source balance S+Beta_CX-alpha*F+OmegaM+Swall from F/m to the physical Boltzmann distribution-rate RHS in F/s by one explicit Vth multiplication.
operation: assemble the neutral Boltzmann right-hand side
thermal speed plus six aligned 3-D fields -> Boltzmann RHS
discovery.model: the explicit Boltzmann RHS assembly; normalized spatial transport with u=v/Vth and inverse-length collision coefficients
discovery.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis; velocity axes are dimensionless u=v/Vth on one common caller normalization
discovery.boundary: thermal speed finite and positive; all six fields finite 3-D arrays with one common shape

identity.relation: Vth*(S + Beta_CX - alpha_c*f + OmegaM + Swall) on a shared 3-D mesh
identity.direction: thermal speed plus six aligned 3-D fields -> Boltzmann RHS
identity.definition: The signed sum: rhs = Vth * (coeff_source + charge_exchange_source_sum - collision_frequency * total_distribution + elastic_source_sum + wall_source_sum).
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis
identity.coordinates: thermal speed is m/s; total_distribution F is m^-3; alpha=nu/Vth is m^-1; each source field is Q/Vth in F/m; rhs is F/s.
identity.boundary: thermal speed finite and positive; all six fields finite 3-D arrays with one common shape
assumptions: The signed sum defines the relation; the sign convention (alpha_c*f subtracted) is preserved.
The caller owns the individual source/frequency fields; this asset only assembles.
SciRel rejects boolean, string and complex coercions and any non-finite RHS produced from finite inputs.

Use one caller-selected Vth: velocity coordinates are u=v/Vth, F integrates over normalized velocity volume to number density in m^-3, alpha=nu/Vth is m^-1, and every source input is Q/Vth in F/m. This callable multiplies the complete balance by thermal_speed_m_s exactly once to return F/s; it does not normalize physical frequency or source inputs for the caller.

inputs.name: coefficient_source_distribution
inputs.description: The coefficient source term. Supply the normalized spatial source Q/Vth, not a physical F/s source.

inputs.name: charge_exchange_source_sum
inputs.description: The CX source sum. Supply the normalized spatial source Q/Vth, not a physical F/s source.

inputs.name: collision_frequency_m_inv
inputs.description: Inverse-length collision coefficient alpha=nu/Vth; the explicit final thermal-speed multiplication restores the physical loss nu*F.

inputs.name: elastic_source_sum
inputs.description: The elastic source sum. Supply the normalized spatial source Q/Vth, not a physical F/s source.

inputs.name: wall_source_sum
inputs.description: The wall source sum. Supply the normalized spatial source Q/Vth, not a physical F/s source.

outputs.name: rhs
outputs.description: Physical distribution-rate RHS; one Vth multiplication converts every normalized spatial balance term from F/m to F/s.

preconditions: Thermal speed finite positive; all six fields finite aligned 3-D.
All input fields must use one common Vth normalization; the explicit thermal_speed_m_s multiplication converts the completed spatial balance to a physical distribution-rate RHS.
supported: Boltzmann RHS assembly for H and H2 neutral transport diagnostics.
excluded: Implicit or nonlinear Boltzmann solvers; external collision models.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the thermal speed is not finite and positive, any field is non-finite, or the fields do not share one common 3-D shape.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if finite inputs overflow to a non-finite RHS.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

python.signature: assemble_neutral_boltzmann_rhs(thermal_speed_m_s, coefficient_source_distribution, charge_exchange_source_sum, collision_frequency_m_inv, total_distribution, elastic_source_sum, wall_source_sum)

example.description: Assemble the Boltzmann RHS from uniform unit fields.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import assemble_neutral_boltzmann_rhs
ones = np.ones((1, 1, 1))
r = assemble_neutral_boltzmann_rhs(5000.0, ones, ones, ones, ones, ones, ones)
# Vth * (1 + 1 - 1*1 + 1 + 1) = 5000 * 3
assert r['rhs'][0, 0, 0] == 15000.0
try:
    assemble_neutral_boltzmann_rhs(float('nan'), ones, ones, ones, ones, ones, ones)
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'positive and finite' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('NaN thermal speed must be rejected')
example.expected: For unit source fields and Vth=5000 m/s, rhs[0,0,0] was 15000.0; NaN thermal speed raised ValueError.

scope: Direct tests bind the signed sum and one final Vth multiplication, shape/finiteness validation, implicit-real rejection and overflowing-output rejection.

The contract example covers one bounded representative call; numerical checks do not establish external physical validation or full-domain applicability.
